inputs.user: I want to cluster the questions based on their technology (i.e. programming langauge, platform, program, etc.). A question can only be assigned to exactly one cluster

outputs.agent:
How should we structure the cluster boundaries when assigning each question to exactly one technology group, given the mix of languages, frameworks, and platforms in this dataset?

A) Strictly by exact language, framework, or platform name (e.g., separate clusters for "MATLAB", "Haskell", "Spring", "BASH", "WordPress")
B) By broader technology category or platform family (e.g., "CMS/PHP Stack", "Java Ecosystem", "Windows/MS Development", "Unix/Scripting")
C) By combining technology with the primary development context or paradigm (e.g., "Scientific Computing", "Web Backend Frameworks", "Desktop/Office Automation")
D) By grouping closely related or frequently co-occurring technologies together to minimize the total number of clusters while keeping them mutually exclusive
E) Other — please describe your preference.
